column2: In real life not everything gets answered right away: a call, a favor or a chat can wait a few days, but ignoring them wears down the relationship.

Family, friends, work, business and fame conversations wait up to 30 days without stopping the clock. When their deadline arrives they appear on their own; if you ignore them, the person loses 6 relationship points (and if they hold grudges, they'll resent you).
The Harvard Study of Adult Development, which has followed hundreds of people since 1938, found that the quality of close relationships predicts happiness and health better than money or fame.

Each month, the average relationship with your partner, children, parents, siblings and friends moves your mood (up to 0.5 points a month, up or down). Three or more grudges lower it a bit more; with no one close, it also drops.
It only changes how amounts are shown. Your savings stay in your country's currency, so in another currency their value goes up or down as the exchange rate moves.

International organizations report in dollars to compare countries, but your purchasing power depends on the currency you earn and spend. An exchange rate converts amounts; it doesn't change what you can buy where you live.
The new name shows across the whole game (map, lists and new news) and is saved in your game. You can restore the original whenever you want.

Countries and companies do change their names: Burma became Myanmar in 1989, Swaziland became Eswatini in 2018 and Turkey asked to be called Türkiye in 2022; companies do it when they merge or rebrand.

Auto-advance: next to the date, ▶ makes time run on its own and ×1, ×2 or ×5 changes the speed (1, 2 or 5 days per second). It stops by itself for dialogues, events, offers, fights, finals and major news. The Hour, Day, Week, Month and Year buttons still work the same.
  • Pending conversations (💬): family, friends, work, business and fame conversations no longer interrupt you: they wait up to 30 days. When their deadline arrives they appear on their own; ignoring them has consequences.
  • Your social life: your close relationships move your mood every month, so what you decide in each conversation keeps counting afterwards.
  • Currency: tap the currency code under your money (or Settings) to see everything in the currency you want.
  • Rename (More → ✏️ Rename): countries, companies, banks, clubs, leagues, organizations, promoters and ministries.
